items.proposal: E3 condition C10 is NOT met (MEASURED from the landed W1 change log, e4_evidence/c_measure.json key C10): the FIXUP-3 author of W1 lists one claim as contradicted by the bytes and, as the TIER-ONLY RULE requires, left it unannotated and uncorrected. Row W1-002 (span Dan.1.8-Dan.1.16), field boundary_rationale, first sentence: the words 'the steward's fear'. EXTRACTED by the orchestrator from the pinned WEB file: verse 1:10 begins 'The prince of the eunuchs said to Daniel' and has the words 'I fear my lord the king'; verse 1:11 first names 'the steward whom the prince of the eunuchs had appointed'. So the fear is spoken by the prince of the eunuchs, and the steward is a second official. The words occur exactly once in that field (MEASURED). The same sentence ends 'ending when the steward keeps giving vegetables (1:16)'; the orchestrator has not judged that clause. Proposal A: order FIXUP-4 for W1 only, one lane: in W1-002.boundary_rationale the author replaces the exact span you word (naming the speaker as the bytes do) and adds the tier annotation that sentence then needs under the unchanged TIER-ONLY RULE and its grammar; nothing else in any row changes. Give the exact 'before -> after' span, and say whether the sentence takes an annotation and which. Proposal B: no row change; the claim goes to the two primaries as a known defect and to the end review. Say which.
